meta.title: mass-reseat · constrained decoding
meta.lede: One junction of a constrained decoder. 1,000 marks carry the model’s odds; the schema closes four tracks, and their weight re-seats on the open ones with every ratio intact.
meta.synthesis: Mass-reseat makes a conserved quantity visible: the marks are counted, never drawn as bars, and the closed bins’ marks travel to the kept ones instead of vanishing. The printed p′ is the same function the marks obey (p ÷ Σkept). Generalised from the type-safe film’s M3 throat.
sources: films/typesafe — the switchyard throat (the production cut this module generalises)
Outlines · XGrammar — masks precomputed per grammar state

captions.queue: Before each token, the model scores every candidate. Here, after “currency”.
captions.close: The schema allows USD, EUR or MXN, so four tracks close.
captions.reseat: Their weight does not vanish. It rides back and re-seats on the open tracks.

meta.title: mass-reseat · the cab problem
meta.lede: Kahneman’s cab problem as conditioning: 1,000 cabs, a witness who is right 80 % of the time. The evidence does not change the city; it picks the denominator.
meta.synthesis: In condition mode nothing is erased: the 710 cabs the witness would call Green stay on the page, faint, so the denominator stays visible. The 290 the witness would call Blue gather into one new whole, and the answer is counted from it: 120 of 290.
sources: Kahneman, Thinking, Fast and Slow, ch. 16 (Causes Trump Statistics)

po.label: A cab hit someone at night. A witness says it was Blue.

params.keepLabel: ringed · the witness would say Blue

foot.queue: each dot is one cab · only {groupPct} of the city’s cabs are Blue
foot.close: right 80 % of the time: {n:blue-saysBlue} Blue cabs called Blue, and {n:green-saysBlue} Green cabs called Blue too
foot.reseat: the other {droppedN} stay, faint: still in the city, no longer in the question
foot.count: of the {keptN} cabs the witness would call Blue, {focusN} are Blue
foot.countOff: no witness: the answer is the base rate, {groupN} of {N}

control.label: Use the witness
control.question: Without the witness, what is the chance the cab was Blue?

notes: the 80 % reliability is the textbook’s, tested at night

captions.queue: A city of 1,000 cabs: 150 Blue, 850 Green. One of them hit someone.
captions.close: Test the witness on every cab. 290 of them would be called Blue.
captions.reseat: Only those 290 are still in question. The rest stay, faint, on the page.
captions.count: Count the Blue ones among them: 120 of 290. About 41 %, not 80 %.
captions.hold: Look at the block: most cabs called Blue are Green.
captions.name: The base rate decides: the evidence only picks the denominator.
